gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-mukta-mahee: Mukta Mahee reads chunky and friendly, with tall lowercase. Wallpoet sits above it as a bold, commanding display heading, its lines broken by gaps where the paper shows through.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-mukta-malar: Stencil-cut and loud, Wallpoet takes the heading, while Mukta Malar keeps its ascenders compressed and neutral. Give that body text a little extra size.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-mukta-vaani: Tall lowercase and gaps where the paper shows through give Wallpoet its commanding look. Mukta Vaani is the contemporary, neutral sans, built on a high-waisted lowercase that carries the quieter text.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-narnoor: Narnoor brings short ascenders above big bowls, a plain sans that stays professional and quiet. And Wallpoet, bold and commanding with smooth curves, gives the pair its loudest voice.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-display: Approachable first, and then some. Noto Sans Display has a tall middle zone in every word, so paragraphs under Wallpoet's heavy heading should feel open and easy to follow.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-play: Clean and professional, Play barely separates its cases. Wallpoet goes bold with smooth curves and little stroke contrast, while Play adds a faint upstroke-downstroke shift that suits steady text.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-port-lligat-sans: Wallpoet commands the top with smooth bends, high-rising lowercase and gaps where paper shows through. Port Lligat Sans stays modern and compact beneath it.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-ramabhadra: Clean and professional, Ramabhadra has a prominent x-height under Wallpoet's bold, commanding heading. Let that body text stay modest in size.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-rambla: Clean lines come from Rambla, whose small letters stand almost as tall as capitals. Rambla does the quiet, neutral work of text, while Wallpoet keeps the bold, commanding display voice.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-recursive: Gaps where the paper shows through make Wallpoet unmistakable, with lowercase that rises high. Recursive answers with pencil-like lines that never thicken or thin, so the pair feels approachable, modern and boldly commanding.
